archive: archive/ holds past editions: read only, never run; to rerun one, use the old release install.
step: step 9 MONTH of ALARM_PIPELINE_V1 section 1, for a FORWARD-ONLY variant (the other side of a STOP), after its MONTH job
question: Did the other side of a STOP hold on Jan-Apr (FORWARD PASS) or not (FORWARD STOP)?

commands.name: decide-forward
commands.does: prints the decision of one forward-only variant from its MONTH job receipts; with --write it appends one DECISIONS row

args.name: --settings
args.meaning: this machine's settings file (KEY=VALUE lines read by _tools/settings_v1.py); always named on the command line

args.name: V
args.meaning: the forward-only variant (VARIANTS reason starts FORWARD ONLY OF <V0>)

args.name: --write
args.meaning: append the DECISIONS row (refused when the same decision is already the latest one)

commands.writes: nothing without --write; with --write one row of RUN/registers/DECISIONS.tsv (through reg_append_v1.py)

refuses.when: REFUSED: <reason> on stderr: bad usage or names; no --settings; the variant not in VARIANTS or not forward-only; its parent not a STOP; --month not a MONTH job of the idea or without the variant; reg_append_v1.py changed; the same decision already written

rules: the parent's Sep-Dec numbers are not used: that side was read after the grade, so they are no test
writes one DECISIONS row with --write, nothing else
dry_run_data: planted by _tools/tests/test_agent_docs_v1.py in a new temp folder: {SETTINGS} its settings file, {WORLD} the folder, {ALARM} this Alarm folder; run AD1_20261029, idea FLOWX
